name: Cin7 Omni
description: Cin7 Omni (go.cin7.com) inventory and order management through API v1: sales orders, quotes, purchase orders, credit notes, contacts, products, stock per branch, branches, payments (read only), stock adjustments, branch transfers and users. Create orders, purchase orders, contacts and transfers. API username and key.
instructions:
## Cin7 Omni
This connector works with **Cin7 Omni**, the original Cin7 inventory and order management system (signs in at `go.cin7.com`), through its REST API v1 at `https://api.cin7.com/api/v1`: sales orders, quotes, purchase orders, credit notes, contacts, products and options, stock per branch, branches, payments (read only), stock adjustments, branch transfers and users.

**Omni or Core?** Cin7 sells two different products. **Cin7 Omni** (this connector) signs in at go.cin7.com and has API v1 with an API username and key. **Cin7 Core** (formerly DEAR Inventory) signs in at inventory.dearsystems.com and has its own API with an Account ID and Application Key: use the `cin7-core` connector for it. The two APIs and their credentials are not interchangeable.

**Setup (about 3 minutes, administrator)**
1. In Cin7 Omni open the user menu, **Settings, Integrations & API, API v1**.
2. Copy the **API Username** shown there into `CIN7_OMNI_API_USERNAME`.
3. Click **Add New API Connection**, give it a name and copy its **API key** into `CIN7_OMNI_API_KEY`.
4. Under **Permissions** tick Read for every resource the AI should see (and Create or Update for the write tools), then **Save**. A resource without permission answers 403.

The connector sends both as HTTP Basic authentication.

**Where to start**: `cin7_omni_list_branches` for branch ids, `cin7_omni_list_sales_orders` for recent orders, `cin7_omni_list_stock` for stock per branch, `cin7_omni_list_contacts` to find a customer or supplier.

**Reading**: sales `cin7_omni_list_sales_orders`, `cin7_omni_get_sales_order`, `cin7_omni_list_quotes`, `cin7_omni_list_credit_notes`, `cin7_omni_get_credit_note`, `cin7_omni_list_payments`; purchasing `cin7_omni_list_purchase_orders`, `cin7_omni_get_purchase_order`; catalogue `cin7_omni_list_products`, `cin7_omni_get_product`, `cin7_omni_list_product_options`, `cin7_omni_list_product_categories`; stock `cin7_omni_list_stock`, `cin7_omni_list_adjustments`, `cin7_omni_list_branch_transfers`; people `cin7_omni_list_contacts`, `cin7_omni_get_contact`, `cin7_omni_list_users`.

**Writing**: `cin7_omni_create_sales_order`, `cin7_omni_update_sales_order` (header fields only), `cin7_omni_create_purchase_order`, `cin7_omni_create_contact`, `cin7_omni_update_contact`, `cin7_omni_create_branch_transfer`. `cin7_omni_create_adjustment` is installed switched off because an approved adjustment changes stock value at once. Writes answer HTTP 200 with a list of `{index, success, id, code, errors}`: always check `success` and `errors`, a refused record still returns 200. Payments are read only: the connector never records, changes or deletes a payment, and it does not dispatch, invoice or void orders.

**Filtering (`where`)**: SQL style on fields of the record, not of line items. Strings and dates in single quotes, numbers bare: `modifiedDate>='2026-01-01T00:00:00Z' AND branchId=3`, `reference LIKE 'SO-10%'`, `id IN (21,24)`. Dates are UTC, `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ`. `fields` trims the answer (`id,reference,total,lineItems(code,qty)`); use it on order lists, which are large. `order` sorts, highest first unless you add `ASC`.

**Paging**: `page` starts at 1, `rows` is at most 250 (default 50 here, 25 on order lists). Ask for the next page until one comes back empty. For a sync, filter on modifiedDate and sort `modifiedDate ASC`.

**Rate limits**: Cin7 Omni allows **3 calls per second, 60 per minute and 5000 per day** per account; beyond that it answers 429 with Retry-After. Prefer large `rows` with narrow `where` filters over many small calls.

**Values**: order `status` is DRAFT, APPROVED or VOID; `stage` is a free text workflow stage (New, Awaiting Payment, Processing, On Hold, Dispatched). Stock `available` is stock on hand minus open sales. Contact `type` is Customer, Supplier or Internal. Write amounts in the order currency; reads return base currency values with the exchange rate.

CIN7_OMNI_API_USERNAME.label: API username
CIN7_OMNI_API_USERNAME.help: Cin7 Omni, Settings, Integrations & API, API v1: the API Username shown at the top of the page.
CIN7_OMNI_API_USERNAME.patternMessage: Paste the API username only, without spaces.

CIN7_OMNI_API_KEY.label: API key
CIN7_OMNI_API_KEY.help: Settings, Integrations & API, API v1, Add New API Connection: copy the API key, then set the connection's permissions and save. Regenerate Key replaces a lost key.
CIN7_OMNI_API_KEY.patternMessage: Paste the API key without spaces.

verifyHints.401: Cin7 Omni refused the API username or key. Copy both again from Settings, Integrations & API, API v1. A Cin7 Core (DEAR) Account ID and Application Key do not work here; use the Cin7 Core connector for those.
verifyHints.403: The API connection has no permission for this resource. In Settings, Integrations & API, API v1 open the connection and tick Read (or Create, Update) for it.
verifyHints.404: Cin7 Omni found no record with that id.
verifyHints.rate_limited: Cin7 Omni allows 3 calls per second, 60 per minute and 5000 per day. Wait for the Retry-After seconds and try again.

prerequisites: A Cin7 Omni account (go.cin7.com) and an administrator who can add an API v1 connection under Settings, Integrations & API. About 3 minutes.

tools.name: cin7_omni_list_sales_orders
tools.description: List sales orders, newest first: id, reference, status (DRAFT, APPROVED, VOID), stage, customer (memberId, company, email), branchId, dates (createdDate, modifiedDate, invoiceDate, dispatchedDate), totals, currency, tracking code and line items. Filter with where, e.g. modifiedDate>='2026-01-01T00:00:00Z' or reference='SO-1001'. Read-only, paginated.

where.description: Filter on fields of the record (not line items), SQL style: strings and dates in single quotes, numbers bare, AND between conditions. Operators = <> > < >= <= LIKE, NOT LIKE, IN, IS, IS NOT. Example: modifiedDate>='2026-01-01T00:00:00Z' AND branchId=3. % is the LIKE wildcard.

fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return (case-insensitive), with line item fields in brackets, e.g. id,reference,total,lineItems(code,qty). Keeps answers small.

order.description: Sort fields, comma-separated; highest first by default, add ASC for ascending, e.g. modifiedDate ASC.

page.description: Page number, starting at 1. Keep going until a page comes back empty.

tools.name: cin7_omni_list_users
tools.description: List the users of the Cin7 Omni account: id, firstName, lastName, jobTitle, email, isActive. Use the id as sales_person_id on orders. New users can take up to 2 hours to appear. Read-only.

tools.name: cin7_omni_create_sales_order
tools.description: Create one sales order. Identify the customer with member_id or member_email (from cin7_omni_list_contacts). The order is approved unless is_approved is false (draft). Cin7 answers HTTP 200 with [{index, success, id, code, errors}]: check success and errors, a refused order still returns 200. Takes no payment.

branch_id.description: Branch id (cin7_omni_list_branches); defaults to the main branch.

reference.description: Order reference; leave empty for the next automatic number.

customer_order_no.description: The customer's own order number (PO number).

is_approved.description: true (default) approves the order; false saves it as a draft.

stage.description: Workflow stage, e.g. New, Awaiting Payment, Processing, On Hold. Default New.

internal_comments.description: Internal comments, not shown to the customer.

currency_code.description: ISO currency code, e.g. NZD; default the account currency.

tax_status.description: Prices including or excluding tax, or exempt. Default the account setting.

productOptionId.description: Product option id, instead of code.

unitPrice.description: Unit price; without it the customer's price column applies.

line_items.description: Lines: [{"code": "SKU-1", "qty": 2, "unitPrice": 9.5}]. Identify the product by code, productOptionId or barcode.

tools.name: cin7_omni_update_sales_order
tools.description: Update header fields of one sales order: stage, tracking code, customer order number, estimated delivery date, delivery instructions, internal comments, sales person. Fields left out stay unchanged. It does not dispatch, invoice or void the order (do that in Cin7). Check success and errors in the [{index, success, id, errors}] answer.

stage.description: Workflow stage, e.g. New, Awaiting Payment, Processing, On Hold, Dispatched.

tools.name: cin7_omni_create_purchase_order
tools.description: Create one purchase order to a supplier (member_id of a Supplier contact). Saved as a draft unless is_approved is true. Check success and errors in the [{index, success, id, errors}] answer.

branch_id.description: Receiving branch id; defaults to the main branch.

reference.description: PO reference; leave empty for the next automatic number.

is_approved.description: false (default) saves a draft; true approves it.

currency_code.description: ISO currency code of the supplier.

productOptionId.description: Product option id, instead of code.

tools.name: cin7_omni_create_contact
tools.description: Create one contact (customer or supplier). Email must be unique. Check success and errors in the [{index, success, id, errors}] answer; id is the new contact id.

price_column.description: Price column used for this contact, e.g. RetailPrice, WholesalePrice.

tools.name: cin7_omni_update_contact
tools.description: Update one contact; only the fields given change. Check success and errors in the [{index, success, id, errors}] answer.

price_column.description: Price column used for this contact, e.g. RetailPrice, WholesalePrice.

on_hold.description: true puts the account on hold.

tools.name: cin7_omni_create_branch_transfer
tools.description: Create a stock transfer between two branches. Saved as a draft unless is_approved is true; dispatch and receipt are done in Cin7. Check success and errors in the [{index, success, id, errors}] answer.

is_approved.description: false (default) saves a draft; true approves it.

productOptionId.description: Product option id, instead of code.

tools.name: cin7_omni_create_adjustment
tools.description: Create a stock adjustment in one branch (positive qty adds stock, negative removes it). Saved as a draft unless is_approved is true; an approved adjustment changes stock on hand and stock value at once. Installed switched off. Check success and errors in the [{index, success, id, errors}] answer.

is_approved.description: false (default) saves a draft; true approves and applies it.

productOptionId.description: Product option id, instead of code.

line_items.description: Lines: [{"code": "SKU-1", "qty": -2}]. qty is the change, negative to remove.
